name: Hamburg

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the eighth season; final scoring follows

categories.label: Victory point track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi tính cuối game
categories.hint: Current position on the VP track (100/200 tile counted).

categories.label: Cards in display (printed points)
categories.labelVi: Thẻ trong khu vực (điểm in trên thẻ)
categories.hint: Every building / Zoo / Park card in your display is worth its printed points.

categories.label: Laurel Wreath buildings
categories.hint: Points per each building's own Laurel Wreath ability.

categories.label: Active majority tokens
categories.hint: 4 VP per majority token on its coloured side (max 5).

categories.label: City wall sides with 3rd segment built
categories.labelVi: Nửa tường thành có đoạn thứ 3
categories.hint: 3 VP per side (left/right) where the third segment is built.

categories.label: Hans Hummel statues
categories.hint: Printed points on each statue on your player board.

categories.label: Clerics on church floor
categories.labelVi: Giáo sĩ trên sàn nhà thờ
categories.hint: For each cleric on the floor: 1 VP per building (right of board) or Zoo/Park (left) in that domain.

categories.label: City Hall Square pawn position
categories.labelVi: Vị trí pawn ở City Hall Square
categories.hint: Points printed on the space your pawn reached (last space 18).

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Many points are gained during play on the VP track; final-scoring items are added on top. Expansions 1 and 2 (e.g. Hans Hummel and the Lemonjette) not modelled. Clerics: 1 point per matching card per cleric on the floor under that domain's window.
